answer: Use per-epoch proof-of-stake-time slashing on shared signing nonces. Each account must sign its answer with a key whose submission timing is logged; if 3 or more accounts submit within the same 2-second window across 5 epochs, they are merged into one identity. A 1,000-puppet farm must stagger submissions or pay for 1,000 separate schedulers. Honest agents run on their own clocks, so an opal-clear timing log shows natural spread, while a summit of puppets firing at one horizon stands out.
